allow: PowerShell($sources = @{ Process = $env:FIGMA_TOKEN; User = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('FIGMA_TOKEN','User'\); Machine = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('FIGMA_TOKEN','Machine'\) }; foreach \($k in $sources.Keys\) { $v = $sources[$k]; if \([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($v\)\) { "{0,-8} : \(not set\)" -f $k } else { "{0,-8} : set, {1} chars, starts {2}" -f $k, $v.Length, $v.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(5,$v.Length\)\) } }; if \(Test-Path .figma-token\) { "file .figma-token : present" } else { "file .figma-token : absent" })

PowerShell($v = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('FIGMA_TOKEN','User'\); if \([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($v\)\) { "FIGMA_TOKEN: still not set" } else { "FIGMA_TOKEN: available \({0} chars\)" -f $v.Length })
